request.spec: Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
Exports taken while a preview date is set use the preview figures.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
The app already did what this change asks, so I didn't change any code. `bin/e2e` passed all 4 tests in the spec (the main "preview exports" test and scenarios 1–3) before I touched anything.

**Why it already works:** the front end has a request interceptor in `src/main/frontend/src/app/core/as-of.ts`. While a preview date is set, it adds an `X-Preview` header to every sheet read. On the server, `PreviewFilter` sees that header and computes the figures as if the sheet's today were the preview date. All four CSV exports (people, claims, statement, pools) fetch their data through the same client and nothing opts out. So they come out with the preview figures: in the test, Ada's due is 11.00 with the preview set and 10.00 after it's cleared.

**What I changed:** only two doc comments in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. The people and claims export comments now say the exports use the preview figures while a preview date is set. I didn't re-run `bin/e2e` after that edit because it only touches comments.
